name: AmbientSoundFlags
meaning: AmbientSoundManager FLAGS property bits (read by AmbientSoundManager_Init 0x494a02 and Update 0x494170)

name: AMBS_CINE_UPDATE
meaning: ScnObject flags |= 0x20: keeps updating (and playing) during cinematics

name: AMBS_POSITIONAL_HORIZONTAL
meaning: if bit1 clear: playFlags |= POSITIONAL|DIST_HORIZONTAL. Also, in box mode the vertical falloff factor is skipped

name: AMBS_LOOP
meaning: playFlags |= SNDF_LOOP: replayed when found stopped (checked every other update), no repeat timer

name: AMBS_LINEAR_FALLOFF
meaning: volume = VOLUME*(1 - dist/MAXDIST), with SNDF_NO_ATTENUATION. Unused in retail data (max FLAGS is 13)
